# Business AI

Business AI is a UK-focused small-business software platform for website enquiries, lead capture, bookings, business knowledge and optional AI-assisted marketing.

Canonical website: https://getbusiness-ai.com/
App: https://app.getbusiness-ai.com/

## Main product pages
- AI Receptionist: https://getbusiness-ai.com/ai-receptionist/
- Small Business AI: https://getbusiness-ai.com/small-business-ai/
- AI Marketing: https://getbusiness-ai.com/ai-marketing/
- AI for Trades: https://getbusiness-ai.com/ai-for-trades/
- Teesside small-business AI: https://getbusiness-ai.com/teesside/

## Resources and guides
- Resources hub: https://getbusiness-ai.com/resources/
- AI website receptionist guide: https://getbusiness-ai.com/resources/ai-website-receptionist-small-business/
- Website enquiry automation guide: https://getbusiness-ai.com/resources/automate-website-enquiries-small-business/
- AI lead capture for trades guide: https://getbusiness-ai.com/resources/ai-lead-capture-trades/

## Product scope
- AI Receptionist currently focuses on web enquiries.
- Business owners can choose human-first, balanced or AI-first handling.
- Business Knowledge can provide context such as services, FAQs and pricing.
- AI Marketing is an optional add-on for content drafts and planning.
- Human review and handover remain part of the product design.

Support: support@getbusiness-ai.com
## About and contact
- About: https://getbusiness-ai.com/about/
- Contact: https://getbusiness-ai.com/contact/
- Public support email: support@getbusiness-ai.com
- Business AI is UK-focused. The public site does not claim a company number, VAT registration, postal address or public telephone number.


## Pilot
- Pilot recruitment: https://getbusiness-ai.com/pilot/
- The pilot is for a small number of businesses using Business AI in normal day-to-day workflows and giving honest feedback.
- Public pilot messaging does not claim live phone answering, guaranteed results, free access, company registration or VAT registration.
